plan.title: Variance partition then treated-vs-control DE in adipose
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 12 human adipose samples (6 treated vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch) with gene-level Salmon-derived counts (12000 x 13, first column gene symbol) and metadata holding condition, sex, and age. The question has two parts: (1) quantify how much expression variance condition, sex, and age each explain per gene, answered with variancePartition on voom log-CPM with precision weights; (2) identify genes differing between treated and control, answered with DESeq2 Wald test adjusted for sex and age, with apeglm LFC shrinkage and BH FDR. One caveat drives the first step: the count matrix has 13 sample columns while metadata has 12 rows, so sample-structure QC must first reconcile sample names between the two files and report any unmatched sample before any model runs. Ranked enrichment (fgsea, Hallmark) follows the DE test to interpret the contrast. All steps follow the knowledge-service procedure snapshot sha256:90c687582244894c67c212e63855415984027bcd54c896821c4e065cf8b5467a.
